# Socialite

> Socialite is a modern social network for sharing posts, stories, photos, real-time chat and video calls with friends and creators.

Socialite combines a familiar feed of posts and stories with built-in messaging and video calling, so people can both broadcast to their community and have private conversations in one place.

## Pages

- [Home feed](/): Public feed of posts and stories from the community.
- [Sign in or sign up](/auth): Create an account or log in to start posting and chatting.
